newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Cisco volatility drops.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Cisco volatility drops.

text.p: Volatility in Cisco Systems Inc options dropped sharply Wednesday in the aftermath of the company's fiscal third quarter earnings report, which was released after the market closed Tuesday.
In afternoon trading, Cisco was up 1-1/16 at 58-13/16 on heavy turnover of about 18.5 million shares. The stock traded between 56-1/4 and 59-1/16.
Cisco reported quarterly profits of $0.52 a share, excluding a $0.03 per share gain, up from $0.37 a year ago.
The number met analysts' consensus estimate but still fell short of some expectations.
